name: Samsung One UI
notes: policy_control is reported working up to One UI 6 (Android 14) - verify with `settings get global policy_control`.
One UI resets icon_blacklist after reboot (since One UI 2.1); it is marked not persistent here and the boot receiver re-applies it.

If icons stay, add Samsung slots (fuseboxon, ims_volte2, right_clock_position, volte, wifi_calling, ...) to icon_blacklist - List real icon slots on the device with `dumpsys statusbar | grep mSlot` and add any missing name to icon_blacklist.

hide.name: policy_control
hide.description: Enable immersive mode globally (status bar hidden, swipe-down preserved)

hide.name: disable_flags
hide.cmd: cmd statusbar send-disable-flag system-icons clock notification-icons
hide.description: Suppress system, notification and clock icon groups (volatile, re-applied on boot)

status.name: icon_blacklist_size
status.description: Byte count of the blacklist (null/4 = key absent)
